newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: San Miguel names three to C-C Amatil board.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel names three to C-C Amatil board.

text.p: San Miguel Corp chairman and chief executive officer Andres Soriano III was among three San Miguel nominations to the board of Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd, C-C Amatil chairman Dean Wills said on Tuesday.

San Miguel has also nominated two other directors to the expanded 16-member board, but had not yet nominated a fourth, independent director, Wills told an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders in Sydney.

The other two nominees were Delfin Gonzalez, San Miguel executive vice president and chief finance officer-treasurer, and Rafael Alunan, a former secretary of the Philippines department of the interior and local government, he said.
San Miguel is taking four seats on the C-C Amatil board as part of a link-up between the two companies.
Under the deal, approved by C-C Amatil shareholders earlier on Tuesday, San Miguel will hold a 25 percent stake in the Australian group, which will acquire San Miguel's soft-drink subsidary.

Wills also rejected criticism at the meeting from the Australian Shareholders Association (ASA) about C-C Amatil's policy on appointing directors. "There is only...one who by any objective criteria could be described as truly an independent director," said the ASA's Ray Wagner.
However, Wills said C-C Amatil was now operating in 18 countries and needed a high level of knowledge and expertise in dealing with global issues.
"Very often the substance is disregarded in preference for the form in matters of this nature," he said.
